Index: .dq-scan.py
===================================================================
--- .dq-scan.py
+++ .dq-scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import json, glob, sys
+
+files = sorted(glob.glob("*.json"))
+dec = json.JSONDecoder()
+bad = []
+ok = 0
+for f in files:
+    raw = open(f, encoding="utf-8").read()
+    idx = 0
+    n = 0
+    while idx < len(raw) and raw[idx] in " \t\r\n":
+        idx += 1
+    try:
+        while idx < len(raw):
+            obj, end = dec.raw_decode(raw, idx)
+            n += 1
+            idx = end
+            while idx < len(raw) and raw[idx] in " \t\r\n":
+                idx += 1
+    except Exception as e:
+        bad.append((f, "decode-error objects=%d: %s" % (n, e)))
+        continue
+    if n != 1:
+        bad.append((f, "objects=%d" % n))
+    else:
+        ok += 1
+
+print("total=%d ok=%d bad=%d" % (len(files), ok, len(bad)))
+for f, why in bad:
+    print("BAD", f, "|", why)
\ No newline at end of file
